author: c4ooo
body:
Basically to help prevent team grieving,and make maps better overall,  I believe a thing should be added to the YAML so you can prevent people taking more the X of a certain block (iron in most cases). If the person dies, the counter should reset so they can mine that block X more times. 
ps sorry if this is bad grammar I am in a hurry. This would e able to be used to prevent people form hogging iron/gold/diamond.
pps: I want this mostly for Nebula DTM
